messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up  I opened a draft PR to tidy up our localization / region-availability docs and add a short data-residency FAQ. Main items: supported-regions table, clarifying hosted vs Dedicated residency, SDK snippets for region param, and a short migration note for hosted->dedicated customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498

Maya Chen: I also found the old private link still points to /private-deployments which 404s. New nav uses /docs/private-deployments/on-prem-and-vpc so I plan to update that link in the FAQ.

Leo Patel: Nice. Can we include both JS and Python SDK examples showing how to set region? Users keep asking how to target eu vs us.

Samir Rao: Agree. Also a migration snippet: what happens to residency when customers move from hosted -> Dedicated, and who owns the KMS/HSM keys after migration. Suggest a short bullet list and a pointer to the enterprise onboarding contact.

Leo Patel: Draft JS snippet:```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-central-1' });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Hello from EU' });
```

Leo Patel: Draft Python snippet:```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'], region='eu-central-1')
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-1', prompt='Hello from EU')
```

Maya Chen: Great. Please paste both as separate fenced blocks under an "SDK usage" heading. Add a one-line note: "region parameter is used for routing in Hosted; Dedicated/Private deployments should be pinned via the Console or deployment config."

Samir Rao: For the data residency FAQ item I propose this language: "Hosted API: routing and processing occur in the selected region for latency; enterprise residency for EU/US is available via Dedicated or Private deployments. For Dedicated/Private, contact sales@redwood.ai for onboarding and KMS/HSM options." Add a link to the Private deployment docs (fixed path).

Maya Chen: Copy edit: under Supported regions we currently list "asia-east-1" but infra inventory shows the region id is "ap-northeast-1". I'll correct that and run a grep across docs to catch other occurrences. Leo, can you double-check there aren't lingering examples with the old code?

Leo Patel: Will grep and send a follow-up commit if anything else appears. Quick note: keep the region names consistent with our infra catalog (us-west-2, eu-central-1, ap-northeast-1).

docs-bot: CI / lint for PR #498 passed :white_check_mark: (spellcheck flagged a nit: residency -> residency.)

Maya Chen: Can @Samir and @Leo review by EOD? We need this merged before the onboarding docs freeze tomorrow. I'll squash-merge after approvals.

Samir Rao: Doing a review now. Found one small thing: the migration paragraph should mention that session logs remain in hosted for 30 days unless customer requests export during migration. Add: "Export of logs and prompt traces must be requested during the migration window; post-migration retention follows the Dedicated tenant policy."

Maya Chen: Good call. I'll add that line and include a contact for migrations: migrations@redwood.ai.

Leo Patel: Small nit on SDK copy: clarify that the region arg is optional and defaults to the tenant's home region if omitted. I'll add that sentence inline.

Maya Chen: Updated in the PR: changed asia-east-1 -> ap-northeast-1, fixed the private docs link to /docs/private-deployments/on-prem-and-vpc, added SDK blocks, and inserted the migration bullets with migrations@redwood.ai contact.

docs-bot: PR #498 updated with 3 commits. Lint: OK.

Leo Patel: LGTM for the SDK/regions parts. One suggestion: add a short example of using the Console to pin region for Dedicated (since SDK region wont affect Dedicated routing). Maybe a one-sentence and a Console screenshot reference (we can add the screenshot in a follow-up).

Samir Rao: LGTM on migration text after adding the export logs note. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Thanks both. I'll wait for one more review then squash and merge. Leaving a release checklist note to update the API reference link (embedding/region routing) if anything else breaks.

Maya Chen: Post-merge action: follow up to add a tiny note in the SDK reference that region param only routes hosted traffic; and update the CLI examples if they use the old asia-east-1 string."
